Programs and Courses of Instruction Generally

law.catch_line: High school student parking passes; valid driver's license required
law.text: Each public high school shall require any student who applies to obtain a pass to park a vehicle on school property to provide evidence that the student possesses a valid driver's license or driver privilege card. The Department shall develop, and each public high school shall utilize, a standard application form for students to use to obtain a pass to park a vehicle on school property.
